name: B10-0088/2025 (PfE) – Case of Boualem Sansal in Algeria
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the case of Boualem Sansal in Algeria
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for the immediate release of Boualem Sansal, a 75-year-old Franco-Algerian writer held in Algeria since November 2024. It asks the European Union and its member states to back France and put pressure on Algeria, including by suspending European Union funding, restricting visas for Algerian officials, and tying the 2025 revision of the European Union-Algeria partnership to his release. The text is a request, not a law, so nothing changes yet.

- The Parliament asks the European Union to suspend funding to Algeria and limit visas for Algerian officials.
- It affects Algeria's government, European Union spending there, and Algerian officials seeking visas.
- Next, the Parliament sends this request to the Council, the Commission and member states; they decide.
